title: Đề 6 – tham khảo kiểu Lômônôxốp
desc: Khuôn tham khảo kiểu Lômônôxốp (đề thứ hai, nội dung khác đề 5).

sections.title: I. Ngữ âm
sections.instruction: Câu 1–2: phát âm; câu 3–4: trọng âm.

items.prompt: Chọn từ có phần gạch chân phát âm khác.
Chọn từ có phần gạch chân phát âm khác.
Chọn từ có trọng âm khác.
items.explain: umbrella nhấn âm 2; chocolate (âm 1), hospital (âm 1), elephant (âm 1).

items.prompt: Chọn từ có trọng âm khác.
items.explain: today nhấn âm 2; lesson (âm 1), carrot (âm 1), garden (âm 1).

sections.title: II. Ngữ pháp và từ vựng

items.prompt: Hoa ___ her grandparents every Sunday.
My sister and I ___ at home last night.
items.explain: My sister and I (số nhiều), quá khứ: were.

items.prompt: This T-shirt is too small. Can I try a ___ size?
items.explain: So với cái đang mặc: bigger.

items.prompt: Don't make ___ noise. The baby is sleeping.
I'll call you ___ I get home.
He is interested ___ collecting stamps.
We'd better ___ now or we'll be late.
items.explain: had better + động từ nguyên mẫu.

items.prompt: There ___ a lot of people at the festival yesterday.
items.explain: a lot of people (số nhiều), quá khứ: were.

items.prompt: My brother is ___ than me, but I'm taller.
items.explain: So sánh hai người: older than.

items.prompt: Mai can't ___ the piano, but she can sing well.
You can see many kinds of fish and sharks at an ___.
They are going to ___ a new school in our town next year.
items.explain: be going to + động từ nguyên mẫu.

sections.title: III. Giao tiếp
sections.instruction: Chọn câu đáp lại phù hợp nhất.

items.prompt: A: "I've got a headache." – B: "___"
items.explain: Khuyên khi bị đau đầu: You should take a rest.

items.prompt: A: "Thank you for helping me." – B: "___"
items.explain: Đáp lời cảm ơn: It's my pleasure.

items.prompt: A: "What's your favourite subject?" – B: "___"
A: "Can I use your dictionary?" – B: "___"
items.explain: Đồng ý cho mượn: Of course. Here you are.

sections.title: IV. Điền từ vào đoạn văn
sections.instruction: Chọn từ đúng cho mỗi chỗ trống.

items.title: A school trip
items.passage: Last Sunday, my class (21) ___ a trip to the Botanical Garden. We went there (22) ___ bus. The garden was very big and (23) ___ were many kinds of trees and flowers. Our teacher told us (24) ___ the plants and their names. We took a lot of photos and had lunch (25) ___ the grass. Everybody was tired but happy. It was a really (26) ___ day.

items.explain: there were + danh từ số nhiều.
Mệt nhưng vui nên ngày tuyệt vời: wonderful.

sections.title: V. Đọc hiểu
sections.instruction: Đọc đoạn văn và chọn đáp án đúng.

items.title: Ben the robot
items.passage: Ben is a robot. He lives with the Smith family in a smart house. Every morning, Ben wakes the children up at 6.30 and makes breakfast for them. He can clean the floor, wash the dishes and water the plants. He cannot cook dinner yet, but Mr Smith is teaching him. In the evening, Ben helps the children with their homework and plays chess with them. The children love Ben, but sometimes he makes mistakes. Last week, he put salt in the coffee instead of sugar!

items.prompt: Where does Ben live?
options: In a smart house with the Smith family
items.explain: "He lives with the Smith family in a smart house".

items.prompt: What time does Ben wake the children up?
What can't Ben do yet?
Who is teaching Ben?
Which is TRUE?
options: Ben plays chess with the children.

items.prompt: What mistake did Ben make last week?
options: He put salt in the coffee.
items.explain: "he put salt in the coffee instead of sugar".

sections.title: VI. Tìm và sửa lỗi
sections.instruction: Mỗi câu có MỘT từ sai. Bấm vào từ sai rồi gõ từ đúng.

items.prompt: Tìm một từ sai và sửa lại
Tìm một từ sai và sửa lại
items.explain: many + danh từ số nhiều: children.

items.prompt: Tìm một từ sai và sửa lại
items.explain: Sau doesn't dùng động từ nguyên mẫu: like.

items.prompt: Tìm một từ sai và sửa lại
items.explain: English bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm: an.

sections.title: VII. Viết lại câu
sections.instruction: Hoàn thành câu thứ hai sao cho nghĩa không đổi.

items.prompt: My bike is older than your bike.
answers: not as old as my bike
not so old as my bike

items.prompt: Shall we go out for dinner?
Nam doesn't swim well.
items.explain: doesn't swim well = is not a good swimmer.

items.prompt: There are 20 rooms in the hotel.
